An 8-year-old boy wearing a sci-fi themed black hoodie takes a break during a visit to the science museum. Sitting on a futuristic-looking bench, he excitedly holds his small phone showing a space-related English learning app, enthusiastically repeating "Astronaut" after it.

A 5-year-old boy wearing soft gray wool socks and home clothes sits on the windowsill, watching the rain outside. A small phone rests on his knees, screen teaching weather terms in English. Listening to the rain, he repeats after the phone: "Rainy day".

A 6-year-old boy wearing light-up sneakers and athletic wear takes a rest on a stone bench in the residential compound garden in the evening, sweat still on his forehead. He takes out a small phone showing a sports English app, panting and smiling as he repeats "Run! Jump!".

Curiously, he uses a small learning phone to look up the English words for tools like "brush" (毛笔), attempting to describe his work in English.

A 4-year-old boy in soft light yellow star-patterned pajamas lies in bed during story time, his mother sitting beside him. Insisting on finishing his daily English lesson on his small phone first, he looks at the screen showing goodnight story words. Sleepy-eyed, he tries hard to say "Moon... Star..." into the phone.
